description: The Private Machines ENFORCER is a general-purpose, tamper-proof cryptographic module. In addition to FIPS level 4 physical tamper protection, the ENFORCER module also provides a secure computing environment, built-in HSM, and firmware-based cryptographic services via FIPS 140-3 approved algorithms.

oes.name: MAX32550 Cortex M3
details: The MAX32550 is a secure micro-controller based on a Cortex M3 processor.
